name: Antares
source:
Year 317.

The war rages on for a decade between Antares and Barian empire. In the midst of turmoil and death, a young guard of a small, northern fortress sets off to turn the tides of a never-ending war.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221105055510/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mikemsrk.Antares]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
317年。

安塔瑞斯与巴里安帝国之间的战争已经持续10年。在混乱与死亡之中，一座北方小要塞的年轻卫兵踏上征途，试图扭转永无止境的战争局势。
